integrity_review.result: All ten candidate paths, page locators, source hashes, unit-content hashes and unit-file hashes agree with the assignment, extraction receipt and current assigned unit files.

candidate_review.limitation: Article 35(1) trigger depends on the applicable processing facts and GDPR scope.
The Article 35(3) examples do not exhaust Article 35(1) high-risk cases.
Article 35(7) specifies minimum content, not a mandatory document format.
Data-subject consultation is qualified by appropriateness; review is tied to necessity and changed risk.
Article 36 material applies to the prior-consultation pathway, not every DPIA.
It states DPO tasks and does not establish a DPO-designation trigger.
The Article 26(9) cross-reference is qualified by applicability and does not establish Article 35 applicability.
The Article 27(4)-(5) material concerns FRIA/DPIA coordination and does not make every AI deployment subject to either assessment.
Educational interpretation cannot establish a legal DPIA or FRIA obligation.
Educational description cannot establish FRIA contents or a universal combined-assessment format.

authority_and_currentness.gdpr: SRC-0010 is operative GDPR text and can support bounded binding candidates, subject to a currentness and applicability check.
authority_and_currentness.ai_act: SRC-0011 is operative AI Act text and can support bounded binding candidates, but the reviewed material does not provide a currentness resolution for Articles 26 and 27. Repository evidence identifies a reviewed binding AI Act amending act (SRC-0043), so an unverified original-text assertion cannot be treated as current binding evidence.
authority_and_currentness.src_0022: SRC-0022 remains educational guidance/context only. It must not support an obligation, prohibition, complete applicability test, or legally required assessment content.

blockers.detail: The evidence audit expressly leaves currentness, amendments and temporal applicability to be confirmed. No hash-bound currentness resolution is included for these provisions; this is required before legal evidence can be marked ready.

Existing repository evidence records SRC-0043 as a reviewed binding amending act for the AI Act, but this lot does not establish whether Articles 26 or 27 are unaffected, superseded or otherwise current.

required_resolution: Create a hash-bound currentness review for the cited GDPR provisions and for AI Act Articles 26 and 27, including any applicable amending or corrigendum text.
Re-run this independent review against the resolved evidence inputs before an evidence lock or domain construction.
warnings: This verdict is an independent evidence review only. It is not legal advice, evidence-lock approval, publication approval or human approval.
